name: structural-file-graphing-reconciliation
body: Audit reconciliation: source SPEC.md (the 0.17.0 brief, §1–§7) vs the branch graph. [autonomous] §1 "127 File nodes; only AGENTS.md, README.md, build.rs present at repo root" is confirmed — those are exactly the repo-root File nodes (`MATCH (n:File)`); no `Cargo.toml`, `install.sh`, `Formula/*.rb`, `.github/**` or `LICENSE` node exists. [autonomous] The targetless list in §1 is confirmed absent from the File-node set. [autonomous] The Markdown precedent is confirmed: modules `md.apg`, `md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans` exist and the md heading Structs are present, so absorbing `mdfrontend` into the bundled scanner preserves the mechanism. [autonomous] §4.5's code-extension claim list matches the frontends actually shipped (go/java/cpp/rust/ts/csharp/py); Ruby has no frontend at all, so `Formula/*.rb` falls to `misc` (pending `apg-ruby`). No brief cell contradicted the graph.
